prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: back strain. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1001; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim received by phone from the insured driver. Side impact collision at a signalized intersection. Insured states they had a green light and the other vehicle entered on red. Statement recorded. Photos of both vehicles requested.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant by phone. Claimant reports neck and lower back pain following the collision and says they were seen at urgent care the same day. No attorney involved; claimant is handling the claim directly. Explained the claims process and that the adjuster will follow up on medical documentation.

Entry 3: Reviewed photos received from insured. Damage consistent with a side impact to the driver's door and rear quarter panel. Intersection camera footage requested from the municipality. Vehicle inspection scheduled with the appraiser.

Entry 4: Medical records received from urgent care. Diagnosis listed as lumbar strain with soft tissue involvement. Follow-up with primary care provider noted. Claimant reports ongoing stiffness when driving and lifting. Reserve adjusted to reflect bodily injury exposure.

Entry 5: Appraisal completed. Repair estimate received and under review. Police report obtained, which cites the other driver for failure to yield. Liability position under review pending receipt of intersection footage. Next step: contact claimant to confirm treatment status and discuss settlement timeline.
